main_body: wooden loom frame with woven cloth
top_band: mid-brown top surface on rows 10-11 with lighter tan front-edge highlight on row 12
evidence: Row 9 is dark brown outline. Rows 10-11 are mid-brown top surface, row 12 is a lighter orange-tan front edge highlight (3 rows total for the top beam). Row 13 is a dark grey-brown eave shadow recessed over the vertical warp threads (rows 14-18) and woven red/yellow pattern (rows 19-21). The lower beam on rows 22-24 also shows a top surface (row 22) and front edge highlight (row 23) above its front face (row 24-25) and legs (rows 26-31).

style.evidence: The loom frame uses simple horizontal bands of flat colour with no wood grain or texture dots, and the warp threads and checkerboard pattern are rigid 1px/2px geometric stripes. Compared to the richly textured cheese stall and roofed well references, the piece looks mechanical, flat, and much lower in information density.
